description:
For user identity 42, the list of affiliated organizations can be accessed through the API endpoint **/api/v1/user_identities/42/organizations**.

The first organization in the list is the **Demo University School of Public Health** (ID 42023191739237). It participates in the 2023 – 2024 academic cycle, is a member of the SOPHAS association, and operates with CAS 3 enabled. Its Config Portal identifier is **2235**. The second organization is the **Global Health Institute** (ID 12345678901234). This institute does not have an associated academic cycle or association (both values are not applicable), it does not use CAS 3, and its Config Portal identifier is **GH123**.
